title: Smoothfy
description: Modern animations and polished transitions make Minecraft's interfaces feel fluid and responsive.
body:
## **Smoothfy**

Smoothfy is a lightweight client side Minecraft mod that adds smooth and polished animations to the game’s interface.

Instead of menus instantly appearing like vanilla Minecraft, Smoothfy makes inventories, chat screens, and interface elements smoothly animate in and out, giving the game a cleaner and more modern feel without changing the vanilla style.

The mod currently includes animated inventory transitions, smooth chat opening and closing animations, and an animated hotbar

![Ejemplo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d806f505902b744a6aed8ff5980ed736818cfbc4.gif)

## **Features**

➤ Smooth inventory animations

➤ Animated chat transitions

➤ Animated hotbar

➤ Modern UI feel

➤ Lightweight and optimized

➤ Fully client-side

➤ Vanilla-friendly design

Smoothfy doesn’t try to redesign Minecraft it simply makes the game feel smoother.

## **Extra**

The mod is in development mode; it will improve over time, and it may also contain bugs.
